name: Lightspeed Restaurant
oneLiner: Cloud restaurant POS from Lightspeed Commerce with table and order management, integrated payments, inventory, multi-location reporting and, since 2026, Lightspeed AI assistants.
bestFor: Full-service restaurants, bars and growing multi-location groups that want a cloud POS with integrated payments, deep reporting and service-pacing tools.

updates.text: Launched Lightspeed AI, an intelligence layer with conversational assistants inside Lightspeed Restaurant that answer operators' questions about their sales and operations.
Unveiled Tempo, service-pacing intelligence that uses real-time dining-flow data to show table pacing, order flow and occupancy, rolled out first to flagship Lightspeed Restaurant customers.
Added digital checklists (Lightspeed Tasks), table pacing and reservations improvements to the restaurant platform.

features: Cloud POS on iPad with floor plans, table management and coursing
Integrated Lightspeed Payments, including pay-at-table and mobile tap-to-pay
Kitchen display system and order routing
Inventory and recipe tracking with menu performance reports
Multi-location menu management and consolidated reporting
Online ordering, reservations and loyalty add-ons
Tempo service-pacing insights for full-service dining rooms
Lightspeed AI assistants for questions about sales and operations

pricing.text: US plans published by Lightspeed: Essential from $189/month and Premium from $399/month (payment processing and add-ons such as KDS screens and reservations cost extra); custom pricing for larger groups.

notes: Owner: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. (NYSE/TSX: LSPD). Dropped from the current review: 'trusted by over 150,000 businesses worldwide' (not re-verified) and the claim that reporting and inventory are 'genuinely stronger than most competitors' (subjective). The $189 Essential price still appears on Lightspeed's US pricing page per search results; a cheaper Starter tier is disputed by third parties, so it was left out. Prices vary by region (UK/AU differ). Tempo availability differs by region and plan per Lightspeed's own support pages. Lightspeed Restaurant also operates in Europe as the K-Series platform.
